name: acp
title: ACP
role: Checkout API that forwards checkout operations to the merchant, whose payment handler receives payment_data. Gateway checkout routes are free and carry no x402 or MPP payment.
subset: discovery and the five checkout operations

features.name: request header forwarding to the merchant

exclusions.name: carts service
exclusions.note: The discovery document advertises only the checkout service.

exclusions.name: webhooks
exclusions.note: The merchant backend sends ACP order webhooks itself.

exclusions.name: Signature header verification
exclusions.note: The adapter forwards the header to the merchant unverified.

exclusions.name: Timestamp replay-window verification
exclusions.note: The adapter forwards the header to the merchant unverified.

deviations.summary: After a merchant 5xx, retrying the same Idempotency-Key returns 409 idempotency_unresolved unless protocols.acp.idempotency.merchantIdempotent is true. The merchant may have acted, so another execution could duplicate the order.

conformance.suite: Our tests against the vendored schema and official examples; ACP publishes no conformance suite.
